every_position_composed.reason: Site 1 keeps the 3D factory line cleanly framed on the right from frame 1 to 9, whereas Site 2 covers the 3D subject with scrolling UI cards in frames 2 and 3 and leaves frame 6 nearly empty.

explains_the_project.reason: Site 1 visually demonstrates the workflow as a continuous machine—pressing the log block in frame 3, storing slices in frame 5, and clamping shifted lines in frames 6 and 7.

craft_of_the_3d.reason: Site 2 features richer metallic materials, specular highlights, and emissive particle streams in frames 1 through 5, though Site 1 is better grounded on its floor grid.

type_and_layout.reason: Site 1 anchors compact, legible cards consistently on the top-left across frames 1 to 9, avoiding the cut-off text boxes and visual clutter seen in Site 2's frames 3, 6, and 7.

overall.reason: Site 1 delivers a cohesive, unobstructed scroll-driven visualization that clearly explains how Straitjacket bounds logs, anchors edits, and routes across harnesses.
